context_for_next_testing_agent: Procurement Payment Enhancement features fully tested and working. Key features: 1) Partial Reimbursement Modal - click rupee icon in SETTLEMENT column for employee-paid procurements to open modal with editable reimbursement amount, 2) Expandable farmer rows in Pending Payments tab - click farmer name or chevron to see date-wise breakdown with checkboxes, 3) Bulk Payment Modal shows date-wise breakdown when selecting specific dates via checkboxes. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_procurement_payment_features.py can be reused for regression testing.
